answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
